name: companion-party-overhaul
author: Always
description: Your companions as a real party of people who live in this world with you. Companion Life and Companion Tactics in one. How they fight: each class in its part, at bosses and in every fight, with orders in party chat and the items you give them. How they live: they talk (greetings, reactions, callouts, about 200 conversations that grow from strangers to close friends), remember your adventures, stand around loosely between fights, look around, and sit beside the one they feel closest to. A Companions window (Alt+N) shows their status, memories, bags, the gear you gave, their colours and the party purse. Options are grouped in the Settings window.

settings.label: Party spacing: Close
settings.description: Between fights they stand within 2 cells of you and follow once you are 3 away. Pick one spacing in the Settings window; none = the game's own tight follow. Changing this restarts the server.

settings.label: Party spacing: Normal
settings.description: Between fights they stand within 4 cells of you and follow once you are 5 away. Changing this restarts the server.

settings.label: Party spacing: Far
settings.description: Between fights they stand within 6 cells of you and follow once you are 7 away. Changing this restarts the server.

settings.label: They look around while you wait
settings.description: While you stand still and nothing is fighting, every 12-30 seconds one companion strolls a few steps to another spot near you, as people do. Scouts (archers, gunslingers) do it twice as often and check a little further out, unless they walk their patrol.

settings.label: Scouts patrol around the party
settings.description: While you stand still and all is quiet, archers, hunters, bards, dancers and gunslingers walk a lap around the party, waypoint to waypoint just outside the others, rest 15-30 seconds, look about, and go round again (sometimes the other way). They stop when you move on, a fight starts, or it's time to sit.

settings.label: Sit down when you wait
settings.description: After a minute with no monster in sight (three for the scouts), companions sit down. They get up when you walk off or a monster shows up. Changing this restarts the server.

settings.label: They sit with their favourite person
settings.description: Before they sit down, each walks over to the one it's most comfortable with: you, or a companion it has talked with a lot, with a heart or a smile. Guardians and Rookies lean to you, Healers to whoever got hurt, Rogues sometimes sit apart, scouts patrol first, Merchants befriend faster. They sit down facing the one they came to.

settings.label: They shift and look around while sitting
settings.description: Once they've sat a while, every few minutes one gets up: it turns to look at you, at whoever just spoke, at a friend or out at the surroundings, or moves to a new spot by its favourite person, then sits again. Rogues keep their spot, Healers stay put while someone's hurt. Needs "Sit down when you wait".

settings.label: Party roles in every fight
settings.description: Not only at bosses: the front line protects you and the back line keeps its distance in ordinary fights too, casters keep area spells for groups, Sages endow weapons. Off: companions fight their own way except at bosses. Changing this restarts the server.

settings.label: Orders in party chat
settings.description: Type in party chat: "assist me"/"focus" and "free fight", "regroup"/"fall back", "heal me", "buff me", "kyrie me", "wall me", "land protector" (Sage), "aoe" (Wizard), "trap" (Hunter), "take a break"/"sit down" and "on your feet"/"let's go". Changing this restarts the server.

settings.label: Use the items you give them
settings.description: Needs Settings > Population > Companion inventory on. They cure poison, silence, blind, curse and confusion (Green Herb, Green Potion, Holy Water, Panacea, Royal Jelly), use Yggdrasil Seed or Berry under 20% HP while hit, and drink their class's speed potion near a boss. Cheapest first. Changing this restarts the server.

settings.label: No buffing in town
settings.description: With no monster in sight (towns, inns) companions don't cast buffs, songs or stances. Once a monster is in sight they buff as usual. Say "buff" in party chat to have them buff you anyway. Heals and revives always work. Changing this restarts the server.

settings.label: What companions call you
settings.description: One or more titles, separated by commas. Each companion keeps one of them, so some call you Boss and others Captain.

settings.label: Greetings
settings.description: When you log in, companions greet you depending on how long you were away (a few minutes, a nap, days). A newly hired companion introduces itself.

settings.label: Reactions to the world
settings.description: Companions comment when you enter a town, field or dungeon, and when you level up.

settings.label: Combat callouts
settings.description: Battle cries, calls for heals, low SP, big hits, a fallen ally, you in danger, spotting and beating a boss, the undead, bad statuses (poison, stun, freeze...), thanks for Blessing and Agi Up, broken gear. Only while things are happening, each with its own cooldown. Changing this restarts the server.

settings.label: They answer you in party chat
settings.description: Say something in party chat and your companions answer in character: hello, good morning, good night, thanks, good job, let's go, how are you, lol, brb, I'm back, sorry, love you, take a break, who are you, hungry. Changing this restarts the server.

settings.label: Daily life
settings.description: Companions cheer when they level up or change job (and the others congratulate them), say so when they sit down to rest and when they're ready again, notice when you've gone quiet for 5 minutes and when you're back, talk about the late night or early morning on your clock, and suggest a break after two hours out.

settings.label: Emotes
settings.description: RO emotes with their lines and callouts: HP! when hurt, SP! when out of mana, sweat when scared, tears when someone falls. At most one every 12 seconds per companion.

settings.label: Minutes between companion conversations
settings.description: Roughly how often companions talk with each other when nothing is going on (or muse to you, if there is only one), varying by 30%. With three or more companions they talk 40% more often, mostly as a group. Topics depend on who's talking, where you are, the hour, a boss just beaten and their memories. 0 turns it off.

settings.label: Party purse: zeny per monster level, per companion
settings.description: Every monster you beat puts this much zeny per monster level into the party purse, for each living companion with you (2 = a level 40 monster with 3 companions adds 240 zeny). The monster's drops still go to you, so this is on top. Take it out (or put zeny in) in the Companions window's Bag tab. 0 turns the purse off.

settings.label: Companions mention the purse
settings.description: Every 15 minutes or so, once at least 1,000 zeny went in, a companion (a Merchant first) says they sold the scraps and how much went into the purse.

settings.label: Memories
settings.description: Each companion remembers your time together: the day and place you met, monsters and MVPs beaten together (your kills while they're with you), places seen, times fallen. They bring it up now and then, and celebrate milestones and anniversaries. Kept with your character.

settings.label: Companions spend their stat points
settings.description: As a companion levels up it earns stat points like you do, but the game only spends them for some kinds of companion. This spends the rest, one at a time at the real cost, on a build that suits its job.

settings.label: Tell me when a companion spends points
settings.description: A line in your chat box with the companion's stats before and after.

settings.label: Fallen companions return when you leave the map
settings.description: While you stay on the map, a fallen companion stays down until a Priest or a Yggdrasil Leaf brings it back. Once you leave (go back to town, warp, or respawn at your save point), it gets back up with full HP and SP and rejoins you. Fixes the game's bug where it stayed dead until you relogged.

settings.label: Tell me when a fallen companion returns
settings.description: A line in your chat box when a companion you left behind gets back up and comes after you.

settings.label: Companions button
settings.description: A small Companions button on screen (drag it anywhere) that opens the Companions window: everyone's HP, SP, level and state, a Memories tab, and a Bag tab (each companion's bag, gear you gave, outfit and hair colour, and the party purse). Alt+N opens it too, with or without the button.
